# `map_from_entries`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Returns a map created from the given array of entries.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
map_from_entries(arrayOfEntries)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `map_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- map_from_entries, example 1
> SELECT map_from_entries(array(struct(1, 'a'), struct(2, 'b')));
{1:"a",2:"b"}
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 2.4.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
